item.title: North Korea Fires Barrage of Missiles, but State Media Remains Silent Again (北, 무더기 미사일 쐈지만...관영매체는 또 ‘침묵’)
item.description:
North Korea Fires Barrage of Missiles, but State Media Remains Silent Again (北, 무더기 미사일 쐈지만...관영매체는 또 ‘침묵’)

The day after North Korea launched a barrage of around ten short-range ballistic missiles toward the East Sea in a provocation, state media remained silent once again, failing to report on the incident. This marks the third time this month. (북한이 동해상으로 단거리 탄도미사일 10여 발을 무더기로 발사하며 도발을 감행한 이튿날 관영 매체들이 또다시 관련 보도를 하지 않고 침묵했다. 이달 들어 세번째다.)

As of 6:30 a.m. on the 21st, North Korean outlets such as the Korean Central News Agency and the Rodong Sinmun had not reported any news regarding the missiles launched the previous day. (조선중앙통신과 노동신문 등 북한 매체는 21일 오전 6시 30분 현재까지 전날 발사한 미사일 관련 소식을 전하지 않았다.)

North Korea typically uses state media reports from early morning the day after a ballistic missile launch to publicize the purpose and results of the launch, and further highlights it if Chairman Kim Jong-un was present to observe. However, it has maintained silence regarding the ballistic missiles launched three times so far this month. (북한은 통상 탄도미사일 발사 다음 날 이른 오전부터 관영 매체 보도를 통해 발사 목적과 성과를 선전하고, 김정은 국무위원장이 참관하면 이를 더욱 부각하지만 이달 들어 3차례 발사한 탄도미사일에 관해선 침묵을 유지하고 있다.)

Earlier, the Joint Chiefs of Staff reported that around 5 p.m. the previous day, it detected around ten short-range ballistic missiles launched from the Pyongyang area toward the East Sea, and stated that South Korea and the United States were analyzing the exact specifications. According to the JCS, the ballistic missiles flew about 300 kilometers. (앞서 합동참모본부는 전날 오후 5시쯤 평양 일대에서 동해상으로 발사된 단거리 탄도미사일 10여 발을 포착했다면서, 한미가 정확한 제원을 분석 중이라고 밝혔다. 합참에 따르면 이 탄도미사일은 300㎞를 비행했다.)

Minister Ahn Gyu-baek noted that the ballistic missiles are believed to be 600mm super-large multiple rocket launchers (KN-25). The 600mm super-large multiple rocket launcher is a weapon aimed at striking South Korea, which the North claims can carry the tactical nuclear warhead "Hwasan-31." With a range of around 400 kilometers, it can only strike the Korean Peninsula. The choice of weapon is interpreted as an intention to pressure South Korea while leaving the door open for dialogue with the United States. (안규백 장관은 이 탄도미사일이 600㎜ 초대형 방사포(KN-25)로 생각된다고 한 바 있다. 600㎜ 초대형 방사포는 북한이 전술 핵탄두 ‘화산-31’을 탑재할 수 있다고 주장하는 대남 타격용 무기다. 사거리 400㎞ 안팎으로 한반도만 타격이 가능하다. 미국과는 대화 가능성을 열어두면서, 한국은 압박하겠다는 의도가 담긴 무기 선택으로 해석된다.)

Professor Park Won-gon of Ewha Womans University said, "It's a message that reducing, not halting, joint exercises is insufficient," adding, "By launching a ballistic missile capable of carrying a tactical nuclear warhead, it likely also contains a message to acknowledge North Korea's nuclear status and begin discussions in future U.S.-North Korea dialogue." (박원곤 이화여대 교수는 “연합 훈련 ‘중단’이 아닌 축소로는 충분치 않다는 메시지”라며 “전술 핵탄두 탑재 가능한 탄도미사일을 발사해 향후 미·북 대화 시 북한의 핵 보유를 인정하고 논의를 시작하자는 메시지도 담겨 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

This ballistic missile launch by North Korea comes eight days after the previous one and marks the 12th such launch this year. The North also launched ballistic missiles on the 6th and 12th of this month. On the 6th, around 5 p.m., one short-range ballistic missile (SRBM) was launched from the Wonsan area, and six days later, on the morning of the 12th at around 6 a.m., another ballistic missile was fired. (북한의 이번 탄도미사일 발사는 8일 만이며, 올해 들어 12번째다. 북한은 지난 6일과 12일에도 탄도미사일을 발사했다. 6일에는 오후 5시께 원산 일대에서 단거리 탄도미사일(SRBM) 1발이 발사됐고, 그 엿새 뒤인 12일 오전 6시에도 탄도미사일 1발을 쐈다.)

item.title: Han Ki-ho: "If He Deserted, He's My Son" — To Ahn Gyu-baek, "Looks Like I'll Be Adopting a Son Out of the Blue" (한기호, “탈영했다면 내가 아들” 안규백에 “졸지에 입양할듯”)
item.description:
Han Ki-ho: "If He Deserted, He's My Son" — To Ahn Gyu-baek, "Looks Like I'll Be Adopting a Son Out of the Blue" (한기호, “탈영했다면 내가 아들” 안규백에 “졸지에 입양할듯”)

People Power Party lawmaker Han Ki-ho said on the 21st, in response to Minister Ahn Gyu-baek denying past suspicions of desertion by saying, "If I deserted, then I'm Han Ki-ho's son," that "I'm suddenly about to adopt a son out of the blue. And not just any son, but a minister's son." (국민의힘 한기호 의원은 21일 안규백 장관이 자신의 과거 군무이탈 의혹을 부인하면서 “탈영했다면 제가 한기호 의원 아들”이라고 말한 것과 관련해 “졸지에 아들을 한 명 입양하게 생겼다. 그것도 장관 아들을”고 했다.)

Han wrote on Facebook that day, "I have not the slightest intention of adopting anyone, but since he insists on being adopted, I suppose I have to accept it." (한 의원은 이날 페이스북에 “추호도 입양할 마음이 없는데 굳이 입양하겠다고 하니 받아들여야겠다”면서 이같이 썼다.)

Earlier, during a full session of the National Assembly's Defense Committee the previous day, Minister Ahn, when suspicions of desertion were raised, said, "I have no shame under the heavens. It's completely contrary to the facts," adding, "If I ever deserted or did anything of the sort, then I'm Han Ki-ho's son." This was a remark aimed at Han, who had first raised the suspicions. Han, who had been absent from the Defense Committee meeting the previous day due to a business trip, issued his response via Facebook on the 21st. (앞서 안 장관은 전날 국회 국방위원회 전체회의에서 군무이탈 의혹이 제기되자 “하늘을 우러러 한 점 부끄러움 없다. 완전히 사실과 다른 내용”이라면서 “만약에 제가 탈영, 이런 부분이 있다면 한기호 의원 아들”이라고 언급했다. 앞서 한 의원이 의혹을 처음 제기한 것을 겨냥한 발언이었다. 전날 국방위에 출장 일정으로 불참한 한 의원은 이에 대해 21일 페이스북을 통해 입장을 밝힌 것이다.)

He went on to say, "At that time, there was no 'desertion' for defense soldiers. They clocked in by stamping when they came to work each day from home, and when they didn't show up, the official term was 'loss.' So the word 'desertion' didn't exist." (그러면서 “당시에 방위병은 ‘탈영’이 없다. 매일 집에서 출근하면 도장을 찍었고, 출근하지 않으면 공식 명칭이 ‘분실’이라고 했으니, ‘탈영’이라는 단어는 없다”고 했다.)

He then asked, "So why does his service record card state '30 days of confinement'? Isn't it because of the 'loss'? And if his discharge date was January 14, 1985, why does the record card show August 31, 1985? Isn't it because he served extra time during the period of 'loss'?" (그러면서 “병적 카드에 ‘구금 30일’은 왜 기록돼 있나. ‘분실’ 때문이 아닌가”라며 “1985년 1월 14일이 소집해제일인데 병적기록 카드에는 1985년 8월 31일로 기록된 것은 분실 기간 추가 근무했기 때문 아닌가”라고 물었다.)

Minister Ahn had declined to answer the previous day when asked by Reform Party lawmaker Cheon Ha-ram whether the '30 days of confinement' was recorded in his service record, saying, "This is currently under investigation by investigative authorities, so my ability to comment is limited." <<>> (안 장관은 전날 ‘구금 30일’이 병적기록부에 기재되어 있냐는 개혁신당 천하람 의원 질문에 “현재 수사기관에서 지금 수사를 하고 있는 사항이기 때문에 제가 말씀드리기는 제한적”이라며 답하지 않았다.)

item.title: Chung Jin-suk on drill reduction: "Lee president sidelined by US, yet cheers" (정점식, 훈련 축소 관련 “李대통령 美에 패싱당하고 환호작약”)
item.description:
Chung Jin-suk on drill reduction: "Lee president sidelined by US, yet cheers" (정점식, 훈련 축소 관련 “李대통령 美에 패싱당하고 환호작약”)

People Power Party floor leader Chung Jin-suk said on the 21st, "How on earth can any country's commander-in-chief cheer and celebrate after being sidelined by an ally over a joint exercise schedule?" This was aimed at President Lee Jae-myung, who said on the night of the 19th that he "expresses respect for the decision" of U.S. President Donald Trump, who ordered the reduction of South Korea-U.S. joint military exercises. (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 “도대체 어느 나라 군 통수권자가 동맹과의 훈련 일정을 패싱당하고 나서 이처럼 환호작약할 수 있나”라고 21일 말했다. 이재명 대통령은 19일 밤 한미연합훈련 축소를 지시한 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령에게 “결단에 경의를 표한다”고 했는데 이를 겨냥한 것이다.)

At a floor meeting held at the National Assembly on the 21st, Floor Leader Chung said, "It seems undeniable that North Korea's nuclear capabilities have already become considerably advanced. With the security situation this grave, President Lee told President Trump he was trying to build a peace regime on the Korean Peninsula by reducing South Korea-U.S. joint exercises — and even expressed respect for it." (정 원내대표는 21일 국회에서 열린 원내대책회의에서 “이미 북한의 핵무장 능력이 상당히 고도화됐다는 것은 부정하기 어려운 현실로 보인다. 이렇게 안보 상황이 엄중한데 이 대통령은 트럼프 대통령을 향해 한미연합훈련을 축소해 한반도 평화 체제를 구축하려 했다면서 무려 경의를 표한다고 했다”고 말했다.)

He added, "Moreover, in his Liberation Day commemorative address, President Lee made proposals to North Korea such as end-of-war discussions between the parties and three grand peace principles for coexistence," calling it "a bizarre case of stalking North Korea." (그러면서 “게다가 이 대통령은 광복절 경축사에서 북한에 당사자 간 종전 논의와 3대 평화 공존 같은 제안을 했다”며 “해괴하기 짝이 없는 대북 스토킹”이라고 했다.)

"Over the past 30 years, the Democratic Party governments have been fooled by North Korea more than once. The Sunshine Policy, the Policy of Peace and Prosperity, the Moon Jae-in administration's Korean Peninsula policy — the Democratic Party's policy of submission to North Korea, which changed only the signboard with each president, was ultimately a fraud against the people," he said, urging "the Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party to acknowledge the errors of past North Korea policies and abandon their North Korea strategy framework." (그는 “지난 30년간 민주당 정권이 북한에 농락당한 것이 한두 번이 아니다. 햇볕 정책, 평화와 번영 정책, 문재인 정부 한반도 정책 등 대통령마다 간판만 바꿔온 민주당의 대북 굴종 정책은 결국 대국민 사기극이었다”며 “이재명 정부와 민주당은 과거 대북 정책의 오류를 인정하고 대북 전략 기조를 폐기해야 한다”고 촉구했다.)

He continued, "No country in history has ever obtained peace by begging its enemy," adding, "Now that North Korea's advanced nuclear capability has become a reality, we must build strong strength to pursue peace in the face of the North Korean nuclear threat." (이어 “역사상 그 어떤 나라도 적에게 구걸해서 평화를 얻은 적은 없다”며 “북핵 고도화가 현실이 된 지금 우리는 북핵에 맞서 평화를 도모할 수 있는 강한 힘을 구축해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Due to President Trump's order for a "drastic reduction," the annual defensive South Korea-U.S. joint exercise "Ulchi Freedom Shield" (UFS) is expected to end as a half-measure that day, having conducted only the first part, the "defense" drill, in the afternoon. The 11-day schedule has been shortened to five days. (트럼프 대통령의 ‘대폭 축소’ 지시로 방어적 성격의 정례 한미 연합연습 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS)는 이날 오후 1부 ‘방어’ 훈련만 한채 반쪽으로 마무리될 예정이다. 11일 일정이 5일로 줄어든 것이다.)

item.title: People Power Party Non-mainstream Faction Members Face Heavy Discipline, Drawing "Political Purge" and "Terror Politics" Accusations (국민의힘 비당권파 4명 중징계에 “정치적 숙청” “공포정치”)
item.description:
People Power Party Non-mainstream Faction Members Face Heavy Discipline, Drawing "Political Purge" and "Terror Politics" Accusations (국민의힘 비당권파 4명 중징계에 “정치적 숙청” “공포정치” )

A day after the People Power Party's ethics committee imposed heavy disciplinary measures, including suspension of party membership rights, on four lawmakers—Cho Kyung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, Seo Beom-soo, and Jin Jong-oh—on the 20th, backlash erupted within the party on the 21st. The affected lawmakers sharpened their rhetoric, calling it "political retaliation" and accusing the party of being "petty conservatives," while party leadership and senior figures also expressed concerns that the measures were "excessive." (국민의힘 윤리위원회가 20일 조경태, 권영진, 서범수, 진종오 의원 등 4명에게 당원권 정지 중징계를 내린 것에 대해 21일 당내에선 반발이 분출했다. 당사자들은 “정치적 보복” “찌질이 보수”라며 날을 세웠고, 당 지도부와 중진들도 “과도하다”고 우려를 표했다.)

◇ Jin Jong-oh: "Political Purge" | Kwon Young-jin: "No Different from a Dictatorial Regime" (◇진종오 “정치적 숙청” 권영진 “독재 정권과 다를 것 없어”)

Lawmaker Jin Jong-oh, responding to the ethics committee's decision to suspend his party membership rights for two years, stated, "This is a political judgment made solely for a leadership blinded by self-interest and the factions that blindly follow them," calling it "political retaliation and a political purge." (진종오 의원은 윤리위가 자신에게 당원권 정지 2년 중징계를 내린 것에 대해 “오직 사욕에 눈먼 일부 지도부와 이를 맹목적으로 추종하는 세력을 위한 정치적 판단”이라며 “정치적 보복이자 정치적 숙청”이라고 했다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly that day, Jin said, "I will never stand idly by as the People Power Party degenerates into such a private party." The previous day, the party's ethics committee decided to suspend Jin's party membership rights for two years, citing reasons such as his public support for independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon during the June 3 by-elections and inappropriate remarks made at a debate in May regarding the "Busan spinning kick" case. (진 의원은 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “국민의힘이 이런 사당(私黨)으로 전락하는 것을 결코 좌시하지 않겠다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 전날 국민의힘 윤리위는 지난 6·3 국회의원 재보궐 선거 당시 무소속 한동훈 의원을 공개 지원하고, 지난달 ‘부산 돌려차기’ 사건 관련 토론회에서 실언을 했다는 이유 등으로 진 의원에게 당원권 정지 2년 징계를 결정했다.)

Jin stated, "I have never officially endorsed or supported independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, which the ethics committee cited as grounds for discipline. Tell me right now—when, where, who did I meet, what did I do, and in what way did I support him?" (진 의원은 “저는 윤리위가 징계 사유로 내세운 무소속 한동훈 후보에 대한 공식적인 지지나 지원을 한 사실이 없다”며 “언제, 어디서, 누구를 만나, 무엇을 했으며 어떤 방법으로 한 후보를 지원했다는 것인지 당장 답하라”고 했다.)

He continued, "Why do you wield the disciplinary sword arbitrarily based on speculation instead of facts? The purpose is clear: to eliminate inconvenient voices, silence those with different opinions, and intimidate anyone who challenges power within the party." (이어 “왜 사실 대신 추측을 근거로 제멋대로 징계의 칼을 휘두르느냐”며 “목적은 명백하다. 불편한 목소리를 제거하고, 다른 의견을 가진 사람을 침묵시키고, 당내 권력에 도전하는 사람을 겁박하려는 것”이라고 했다.)

Later, speaking with reporters, Jin said, "Since I haven't received the official decision document yet, rather than discussing a court injunction immediately, I will review this legally. Given that discipline was imposed without verifying the facts, a thorough legal review is necessary." (진 의원은 이후 기자들과 만나 “결정문을 통보받지 않은 상황이라 아직 법원 가처분을 말하기보단, 법률적으로 검토를 해볼 것”이라며 “사실관계를 확인하지 않은 상황에서 징계를 내린 것에 대해 충분히 법적 검토가 필요하다”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Kwon Young-jin, who received a 1-year-6-month suspension of party membership rights, said on CBS radio that day, "How is this any different from the past dictatorial regimes creating crackdown situations versus the current disciplinary situation?" Kwon had been referred to the ethics committee after grabbing the collar of floor leader Chung Point-sik during a dispute over committee assignments in the National Assembly last month. (당원권 정지 1년 6개월을 받은 권영진 의원은 이날 CBS 라디오에서 “과거 독재 정권이 사정 정국을 만드는 것과 지금 징계 정국이나 다를 게 뭐가 있느냐”고 했다. 권 의원은 지난달 국회 상임위원회 배치 문제로 정점식 원내대표에게 항의하다가 정 원내대표의 멱살을 잡아 윤리위에 회부됐었다.)

Kwon added, "Isn't this about politically eliminating opposition forces and silencing them? By summoning the ethics committee members, the pro-Chang Dong-hyuk faction is replicating that kind of dirty politics." (권 의원은 “반대 세력들을 정치적으로 제거하고, 입틀막 하기 위한 것 아니냐”며 “장동혁 당권파가 못된 정치를 비슷하게 배워 와 윤리위원들을 불러서 (징계 정치를) 하는 것”이라고 했다.)

Targeting party leader Chang Dong-hyuk, Kwon also said, "Isn't the biggest violator of party rules Chang himself? I am determined to dedicate myself to building a conservatism that innovates, unites, and wins—not the petty conservatism of people like Chang Dong-hyuk." (권 의원은 또 장 대표를 겨냥해 “최고의 해당 행위를 한 사람은 장 대표 자신 아니냐”며 “보수를 혁신하고 통합해서 이기는 보수 만드는, 장동혁 같은 찌질이 보수가 아닌 그런 보수 만드는 데 제 몸을 바치려고 각오했다”고 했다.)

◇ Leadership and Former Mainstream Also Express "Concerns" (◇지도부, 구주류도 ‘우려’)

Supreme Council member Kim Jae-won, part of the PPP leadership, said on SBS radio that day, "I have serious concerns about resolving internal party issues through disciplinary action. Unless there's a judgment that someone can no longer work with us in the conservative camp, I believe excessive discipline is undesirable." He added, "We should refrain from solving problems through punishment." (국민의힘 지도부인 김재원 최고위원은 이날 SBS 라디오에서 “당내 문제를 징계로 해결하는 것 자체에 대해 저는 굉장히 우려하는 입장”이라며 “우리 보수진영에서 함께 할 수 없다 정도의 판단이 있으면 모를까, 과도한 징계는 바람직하지 않다는 생각을 갖고 있다”고 했다. 또 “징계를 통해 문제를 해결하는 것은 조금 삼가야된다”고 했다.)

Five-term lawmaker Yoon Sang-hyun wrote on Facebook, "I earnestly request Chang Dong-hyuk and the leadership to reconsider the heavy suspension of party membership rights. At a time when the party's approval ratings are falling or stagnant, I ask whether issuing such heavy suspensions simultaneously aligns with the expectations of the public." (5선 중진인 윤상현 의원은 페이스북에 “장동혁 대표와 지도부에 간곡히 요청한다. 당원권 정지 중징계를 재고해달라”며 “당 지지율이 하락하거나 정체돼있는 이 시점에 동시다발적으로 당원권 정지라는 무거운 징계를 내린 것이 과연 국민 눈높이에 맞는 것인지 되돌아봐 달라”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun wrote on Facebook the previous day, "If party discipline is enforced with a knife rather than built on respected leadership, it will inevitably be a castle in the air. We must not emulate the flawed example of the Lee Jae-myung administration, which practices terror politics by declaring 'shut up and investigate,' 'shut up and indict,' and 'shut up and sentence.'" (김기현 의원은 전날 페이스북에 “정당의 기강을 존중받는 리더십에 기반하여 세우지 않고 칼로 세우려 한다면 사상누각이 될 수밖에 없다”며 “이재명 정권이 ‘닥치고 수사’ ‘닥치고 기소’ ‘닥치고 실형’을 선고하며 공포정치를 자행하는 잘못된 모습을 그대로 답습해선 안 된다”고 했다.)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, who was expelled from the PPP, also joined the criticism, calling it "disciplinary politics for the privatization of the party." In a Facebook post that day, Han said, "At a time when crises for the Lee Jae-myung Democratic Party are exploding—such as the lynching of Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae, diplomatic failures with the U.S. like suspending joint military exercises, buildup for a second-term constitutional amendment, worsening public opinion over abolishing supplementary investigations, and real estate tax hikes—once again, disciplinary politics for the privatization of an opposition party is covering all of that up and helping the embattled Lee Jae-myung regime." (국민의힘에서 제명된 무소속 한동훈 의원도 “개인 사당화를 위한 징계 정치”라며 비판에 가세했다. 한 의원은 이날 페이스북 글에서 “이재명 민주당의 조희대 대법원장 린치, 한미연합훈련 중단 등 대미외교 실패, 연임개헌 빌드업, 보완수사 폐지 여론악화, 부동산 증세 등 국민들께 부각돼야 할 민주당의 위기 이슈들이 폭발하고 있는 시점에, 또 다시 야당의 개인 사당화를 위한 징계 정치가 모든 것을 덮어주며 위기에 빠진 이재명 민주당 정권을 도와주고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee's approval rating at 45%... Positive and negative assessments tied [Korea Gallup] (李대통령 지지율 45%로…긍정·부정 평가 동률[한국갤럽])
item.description:
President Lee's approval rating at 45%... Positive and negative assessments tied [Korea Gallup] (李대통령 지지율 45%로…긍정·부정 평가 동률[한국갤럽])

A poll released on the 21st showed that President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating for state affairs rose slightly from last week, when it hit a record low since taking office, becoming tied with negative assessments. (이재명 대통령의 국정 지지율이 취임 후 최저치를 기록한 지난주보다 소폭 상승해 부정 평가와 동률을 이뤘다는 여론조사 결과가 21일 나왔다.)

According to a survey conducted by Korea Gallup from the 18th to the 20th among 1,004 people aged 18 and older nationwide and released the same day, positive evaluations of the president's job performance stood at 45%. In the Korea Gallup poll released on the 14th, it recorded 44%, the lowest since taking office, marking a rebound of 1 percentage point (p) in one week. (한국갤럽이 18~20일 전국 만 18세 이상 1004명에게 조사해 이날 공개한 여론조사에 따르면 이 대통령의 직무수행에 대한 긍정 평가는 45%로 나타났다. 지난 14일 공개된 한국갤럽 조사에서는 취임 후 최저치인 44%를 기록했는데 1주 사이 1%포인트(p) 반등한 수치다.)

Negative evaluations of the president's job performance were 45%, tied with positive assessments. Negative ratings fell by 1%p from last week. Eleven percent of respondents withheld their opinion. (대통령 직무 수행에 대한 부정 평가는 45%로 긍정 평가와 동률을 이뤘다. 부정 평가는 지난주보다 1%p 하락했다. 11%의 응답자는 의견을 유보했다.)

Respondents who gave positive evaluations cited 'diplomacy' (19%), 'economy/livelihood' (11%), 'doing well overall' and 'communication' (7% each) as reasons. (긍정 평가한 응답자들은 ‘외교’(19%), ‘경제/민생’(11%), ‘전반적으로 잘한다’·‘소통’(이상 7%) 등을 이유로 꼽았다.)

Respondents who gave negative evaluations cited 'real estate policy' (28%) as the biggest problem, followed by 'economy/livelihood' (12%) and 'defense/security/North Korea' (7%). (부정 평가한 응답자들은 ‘부동산 정책’(28%)을 가장 큰 문제로 꼽았고, ‘경제/민생’(12%), ‘국방/안보/대북’(7%) 등이 뒤를 이었다.)

In party support ratings, the Democratic Party of Korea recorded 41% and the People Power Party 25%. Both parties recorded the same support as the previous survey. The Reform Party, the Rebuilding Korea Party, and the Progressive Party each recorded 2% support, while those without a preferred party stood at 26%. (정당 지지도는 더불어민주당이 41%, 국민의힘 25%로 나타났다. 양당 모두 직전 조사와 동일한 지지도를 기록했다. 개혁신당과 조국혁신당, 진보당의 지지율은 각각 2%였으며 지지하는 정당이 없는 무당층은 26%였다.)

This survey was conducted using a telephone interviewer method with randomly sampled wireless phone virtual numbers. The margin of sampling error is ±3.1%p at a 95% confidence level, with a contact rate of 45.6% and a response rate of 10.0%. For details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (이번 조사는 무작위 추출된 무선전화 가상번호에 전화 조사원 인터뷰 방식으로 진행됐다. 표본오차는 95% 신뢰수준에 ±3.1%p, 접촉률은 45.6%, 응답률은 10.0%다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조.)

item.title: 82 civic groups and 51 veterans' organizations... "Fully scrap the plan to integrate the Korea National Defense University Military Academy" (82개 시민단체·51개 예비역단체…“국군사관학교 통합 전면 백지화”)
item.description:
82 civic groups and 51 veterans' organizations... "Fully scrap the plan to integrate the Korea National Defense University Military Academy" (82개 시민단체·51개 예비역단체…“국군사관학교 통합 전면 백지화”)

A pan-national coalition opposing the government's plan to consolidate the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies into a single "Korea National Defense University Military Academy" was launched on the 21st. (육·해·공군사관학교를 통폐합해 단일 ‘국군사관학교’를 신설하려는 정부 계획에 반대하는 범국민 연합체가 21일 출범했다.)

The "National Solidarity to Block the Closure of Military Academies," comprising 82 civic organizations and 51 veterans' security groups nationwide, held a founding press conference at the National Assembly Communication Hall that morning and stated, "The government and the Ministry of National Defense must immediately and fully scrap the plan to abolish the three service academies and establish a single Korea National Defense University Military Academy." (전국 82개 시민사회단체와 51개 예비역 안보단체로 구성된 ‘사관학교 폐교 저지 국민연대’는 이날 오전 국회 소통관에서 발족 기자회견을 열고 “정부와 국방부는 3군 사관학교 폐교 및 단일 국군사관학교 창설 계획을 즉각 전면 백지화하라”고 했다.)

The National Solidarity announced it would begin its campaign against the government, including launching a "10 million-person pan-national signature drive against the closure of military academies," forming a "National Verification Panel" to examine the unconstitutionality and risks of the government's policy, holding an "official inauguration ceremony and pan-national resolution rally," and organizing a massive pan-national protest. In their resolution, they demanded that the government and the Ministry of National Defense fully scrap the plan to abolish the three service academies and create a single Korea National Defense University Military Academy, stop security self-harm driven by the political logic of non-experts, and issue apologies from those responsible for policies that have undermined defense independence and the honor of the officer corps. (국민연대는 ‘사관학교 폐교 저지 1000만 범국민 서명운동’ 전개, 정부 정책의 위헌성·위험성을 검증할 ‘국민 검증단’ 출범, ‘공식 발대식 및 범국민 결의대회’ 개최, 대규모 범국민 궐기대회 등 대정부 투쟁을 시작하겠다고 했다. 이들은 결의문을 통해 정부와 국방부에 3군 사관학교 폐교 및 단일 국군사관학교 창설 계획 전면 백지화, 비전문가들의 정치 논리에 의한 안보 자해 행위 중단, 국방 독립성과 장교단 명예를 훼손한 정책 책임자들의 사과 등을 요구했다.)

Lee Hee-beom, chairman of the NGO Federation, said in his opening remarks at the press conference, "The three service academies, the cradle of patriotism that has protected the nation for nearly 80 years, are on the verge of disappearing in an instant," and stressed, "The government is unilaterally pushing the consolidation of the academies under the guise of 'strengthening jointness.'" Lee Jeong-rin, former Deputy Minister of National Defense, said, "People from politics who lack military experience and insight, along with civilian scholars stuck in armchair theorizing, are leading defense education," and added, "The Minister of National Defense nods to senior military figures but then flips his promises at a word from the presidential office." This is a claim that Minister Ahn Kyu-baek, who said he would consider maintaining the three academies regarding their integration, later reversed his position. (이희범 NGO 총연합회장은 기자회견 모두발언에서 “80년 가까이 조국을 지켜온 호국의 요람인 3군 사관학교가 일순간에 사라질 위기에 처했다”며 “정부가 ‘합동성 강화’라는 포장지를 씌워 사관학교 통폐합을 일방적으로 밀어붙이고 있다”고 강조했다. 이정린 전 국방차관은 “군 복무 경험도 식견도 부족한 정치인 출신과 탁상공론에 갇힌 민간 학자들이 국방 교육을 주도하고 있다”며 “국방부 장관은 군 원로들에게 고개를 끄덕이고도 돌아서면 청와대 말 한마디에 약속을 뒤집었다”고 했다. 안규백 장관이 사관학교 통합과 관련해 3군 사관학교 존치도 검토하겠다고 했다가 입장을 바꿨다는 취지의 주장이다.)

Cho Sung-hwan, co-representative of the Proper Government Model Council, argued, "Abandoning the existing three campuses and building a new school in the provinces would cost at least 10 trillion won," and "Tax money that should be spent on improving treatment and securing advanced weapons must not be wasted on civil engineering projects meant to build political achievements." (조성환 정교모 공동대표는 “기존 3개 캠퍼스를 버리고 지방에 새 학교를 짓는 데만 최소 10조원 이상이 들어간다”며 “처우 개선과 첨단 무기 확보에 쓰여야 할 세금이 정치적 치적 쌓기용 토목공사에 낭비돼선 안 된다”고 주장했다.)

The Ministry of National Defense plans to hold a "public hearing on the establishment of the Korea National Defense University Military Academy" on the 26th at the Defense Convention in Yongsan, Seoul. Kim Hong-cheol, head of the Defense Policy Office (Air Force Academy Class 39), will attend as the ministry's representative. In this regard, Kim Eun-gu, standing representative of Truth Korea, said, "The president already firmly stated on the 5th during the ministry's work report and on the 18th at the Ulchi Cabinet meeting to 'push forward unwaveringly with the creation of the Korea National Defense University Military Academy,' so this hearing is nothing more than a perfunctory exercise to dampen opposition." <<>> (국방부는 오는 26일 서울 용산 국방컨벤션에서 ‘국군사관학교 창설 추진 관련 공청회’를 열 계획이다. 김홍철 국방정책실장(공사39기)이 국방부 대표로 참석한다. 이와 관련해 김은구 트루스코리아 상임대표는 “대통령이 이미 지난 5일 국방부 업무보고와 18일 을지 국무회의에서 ‘국군사관학교 창설을 흔들림 없이 추진하라’고 못 박아놓고 여는 공청회는 반대 여론을 잠재우기 위한 요식행위에 불과하다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Ruling Party's Supreme Council Approves Appointed Members Jeon Yong-gi and Kwon Mi-kyung; Three Pro-Cheong Candidates Leave Before Vote (與 최고위, 지명직 최고 전용기·권미경 의결… 친청계 3명 의결 전 퇴장)
item.description:
Ruling Party's Supreme Council Approves Appointed Members Jeon Yong-gi and Kwon Mi-kyung; Three Pro-Cheong Candidates Leave Before Vote (與 최고위, 지명직 최고 전용기·권미경 의결… 친청계 3명 의결 전 퇴장)

<<>> The Democratic Party of Korea's Supreme Council voted on the 21st to appoint lawmaker Jeon Yong-gi and Kwon Mi-kyung, chair of the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions' National Public Solidarity Union Federation, as appointed members. This came just one day after Representative Kim Min-seok named the two at a general assembly of lawmakers the previous day, prompting backlash from three pro-Cheong (pro-Cheong Wa Dae) Supreme Council members. The three pro-Cheong members did not participate in the vote. ()

At the open remarks portion of the party's Supreme Council meeting held that morning at Gangneung City Hall in Gangwon Province, Representative Kim said, "I'm relieved to be able to report that the motion to appoint Representative Jeon and Chair Kwon has been approved by the Supreme Council today and can now be submitted to the party affairs committee." (더불어민주당 최고위원회가 21일 지명직 최고위원에 전용기 의원과 권미경 한국노총 전국공공연대노동조합연맹 위원장을 임명하는 안건을 의결했다. 김민석 대표가 전날 의원총회에서 두 사람을 지명하고 친정청래계 최고위원 3명이 반발하고 나선 지 하루 만이다. 친청 최고위원 3명은 의결에 불참했다.)

According to the Democratic Party's constitution, the party leader can appoint up to two appointed Supreme Council members, with the appointment finalized after approval by the Supreme Council and ratification by the party affairs committee. However, pro-Cheong Supreme Council members Choi Min-hee, Lee Sung-yoon, and Han Min-soo have objected, arguing that Representative Kim named the two without consulting the other Supreme Council members, and that he broke his campaign promise from the party leadership race, in which he pledged that one of the appointed seats—the youth Supreme Council member—would be chosen through a "festival-style selection method." (김 대표는 이날 오전 강원 강릉시청에서 열린 당 최고위원회의 공개 발언 시간에 “전 의원과 권 위원장 두 분을 (임명하는 안건을) 오늘 최고위 의결을 거쳐 당무위원회에 올릴 수 있게 됐다는 보고를 드릴 수 있게 돼 다행”이라고 밝혔다.)

Representative Kim said, "At the party convention, it would have been better if the youth Supreme Council member had been elected alongside the five elected members, but I felt regret that internal circumstances prevented that, and I thought it would be good to use the appointed slot for the election if possible." He added, "Due to various circumstances, that (election) wasn't feasible, so I had no choice but to make an appointment." (민주당 당헌에 따르면, 당대표는 2명 이내의 지명직 최고위원을 지명할 수 있고, 최고위가 의결하고 당무위가 인준하면 임명이 확정된다. 그러나 친청계 최민희·이성윤·한민수 최고위원은 김 대표가 최고위원들과 협의하지 않고 2명을 지명했고, 당대표 경선에서 지명직 중 1명인 청년 최고위원은 ‘축제형 선출 방식’을 통해 뽑겠다고 공약해 놓고 이를 어겼다며 반발해 왔다.)

Representative Kim continued, "Regarding improving the regrettable system (for electing the youth member), I will begin discussions on amending the party constitution and rules so that the youth member can be elected at the next party convention." (김 대표는 “전당대회 때 청년 최고위원이 5인의 선출직 최고위원과 같이 선출되는 방식이었으면 좋았겠지만, 내부 사정으로 (그런 방식이) 되지 못한 데 대한 아쉬움이 있고, 지명직 몫을 활용해서라도 (선출)할 수 있으면 좋겠다는 생각을 갖고 있었다”고 했다. 그러면서 “그것(선출)이 여러 정황상 안 돼서 불가피하게 지명하게 됐다”고 했다.)

Supreme Council member Choi said, "We tried as much as possible to hold a primary with participation from people in their 20s and 30s, but due to various internal shortcomings, a primary isn't possible, but it looks like we'll appoint a good youth Supreme Council member." (김 대표는 이어서 “아쉬운 (청년 최고위원 선출) 제도 개선에 관해서는, 다음 전당대회 때는 청년을 (선출하는 것으로) 할 수 있도록 당헌·당규 개정 논의를 시작하겠다”고 했다.)

Choi added, "However, Representative Kim has promised that next time, mandatory allocation for the youth Supreme Council member (as an elected position) will be implemented," and said, "I will make sure that promise is kept—I will also monitor that." (최 최고위원은 “저희가 가급적이면 2030이 참여하는 경선을 하려 했는데, 이런저런 당내의 미비 때문에 경선은 못 하지만 좋은 청년 최고위원을 임명하게 될 것 같다”고 했다.)

It was reported, however, that Choi and the other two pro-Cheong members did not participate in the vote during the closed-door meeting held prior to the open remarks portion of the Supreme Council session. Senior spokesperson Park Sung-joon explained, "Members Choi Min-hee, Lee Sung-yoon, and Han Min-soo left without participating in the vote," and "The vote was carried out by the remaining members." (최 최고위원은 “그러나 다음에는 청년 최고위원을 (선출직으로) 의무 할당하는 부분을 김 대표가 약속했다”며 “꼭 지키도록, 이 또한 제가 감시하도록 하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Senior Unification Ministry Official on Kim Yo-jong's 'Ridiculing Statement': "No Denigration or Distortion" (통일부 고위당국자, 김여정 ‘조롱 담화’에 “상대 폄훼·왜곡 안 돼”)
item.description:
Senior Unification Ministry Official on Kim Yo-jong's 'Ridiculing Statement': "No Denigration or Distortion" (통일부 고위당국자, 김여정 ‘조롱 담화’에 “상대 폄훼·왜곡 안 돼”)

A senior official at the Ministry of Unification said on the 21st, regarding the statement by Kim Yo-jong, sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un and vice department director of the Workers' Party, which attacked President Lee Jae-myung by name, that "there should be no denigration or distortion." (통일부 고위 당국자는 21일 이재명 대통령을 실명 비난한 김정은 북한 국무위원장의 동생인 김여정 노동당 부장 담화와 관련해 “폄훼나 왜곡이 있어서는 안 된다”고 말했다.)

Meeting with reporters that morning, the senior official said, "Peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula, peaceful coexistence, and a peace regime require the two Koreas to look in the same direction." He added, "Isn't North Korea also seeking to walk the path of a normal state? The core of the process of becoming a normal state is consideration and respect for the other side." (고위 당국자는 이날 오전 기자들과 만나 “한반도 평화안정, 평화공존, 평화체제는 남북이 같은 방향을 바라보지 않으면 안 된다”고 했다. 그러면서 “북한도 정상 국가의 길을 가고자 하는 것 아니냐”며 “정상 국가화 과정의 핵심은 상대방에 대한 배려와 존중”이라고 했다.)

The Ministry of Unification issued a separate statement that day regarding Kim Yo-jong's message, urging, "Do not distort our will for peace on the Korean Peninsula, and join us on the journey to transform the unstable armistice regime into a peace regime for the benefit and security of both Koreas." (통일부는 이날 김여정 담화 관련 별도 입장을 내고 “우리의 한반도 평화 의지를 왜곡하지 말고, 남북 모두의 이익과 안전을 위해 불안정한 정전체제를 평화체제로 전환하는 여정에 함께해줄 것을 촉구한다”고 했다.)

In her statement the previous day, Kim Yo-jong, referring to the reduction of the South Korea-U.S. joint exercise "Ulchi Freedom Shield" (UFS) at the direction of U.S. President Donald Trump, said, "With a single word from Trump, Seoul has been placed in a pitiful and lamentable position of having to dismantle its most beloved war-game arena," and she also attacked President Lee by name, calling his actions "dualistic words and deeds that differ inside and out." (김여정은 전날 담화에서 도널드 트럼프 미 대통령의 지시로 한미 연합 연습 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS)가 축소된 데 대해 “트럼프의 말 한마디에 서울은 제일 즐겨하던 전쟁놀이 판을 거두어야 하는 가긍(可矜·가엽고 불쌍하다)한 처지에 놓이게 됐다”고 했고, 이 대통령에 대해서도 “안팎이 다른 이중적 언행”이라며 실명 비난했다.)

The senior official at the Ministry of Unification said, "The North Korean nuclear issue is fundamentally a product of hostile relations between North Korea and the United States, and just as the process that has unfolded has been lengthy, the journey toward a denuclearized Korean Peninsula is bound to be long as well." He added, "The most realistic step is to stop first." He explained, "A car running forward cannot go into reverse," and "only by stopping can it reverse." (통일부 고위 당국자는 “북핵은 기본적으로 북미 적대 관계의 산물이고, 진행돼 온 과정이 길었던 만큼 핵 없는 한반도를 향해 가는 과정도 길 수밖에 없다”며 “가장 현실적인 것은 우선 멈춰야 한다”고 했다. 그는 “자동차가 달리면서 후진은 못 한다”며 “멈춰야 후진할 수 있다”고 했다.)

When asked about concerns over South Korea being sidelined in the process of pursuing U.S.-North Korea dialogue, the senior official said, "Realistically, only once U.S.-North Korea dialogue gets underway can we shift from maintaining the status quo to breaking it." (고위 당국자는 미·북 대화 추진 과정에서 한국 패싱(무시) 우려가 나온다는 지적에는 “현실적으로 미·북 대화가 시동이 걸려야 현상 유지를 현상 타파로 바꿀 수 있다”고 했다.)

He said, "I don't believe the United States will designate North Korea as a nuclear state or label it as such," adding, "However, I am stating the reality. North Korea possessing nuclear weapons is a fact." (그는 “미국이 북한을 핵보유국으로 지정하고 명명할 일은 없으리라고 생각한다”며 “다만 현실을 말한 것이다. 북한이 핵을 가지고 있는 건 현실”이라고 했다.)

On concerns that the United States might tolerate North Korea's nuclear program and pursue U.S.-North Korea negotiations, he said, "Rather than focusing on tolerating the North Korean nuclear program, the focus should be on a halt." (미국이 북핵을 용인하고 미·북 협상을 추진할 수 있다는 우려에 대해서는 “북핵 용인에 초점을 맞추지 말고 중단에 맞춰야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Blue House: On Kim Yo-jong's Taunts and Insults, "Defamatory Remarks Do Not Help Mutual Trust" (靑, 김여정 조롱·막말에 “비방적 언사, 상호 신뢰에 도움안돼”)
item.description:
Blue House: On Kim Yo-jong's Taunts and Insults, "Defamatory Remarks Do Not Help Mutual Trust" (靑, 김여정 조롱·막말에 “비방적 언사, 상호 신뢰에 도움안돼”)

The Blue House responded on the 21st to Kim Yo-jong, department director of the Workers' Party, who on the 20th issued a statement filled with taunts and harsh words toward South Korea, saying, "Defamatory remarks against our government and president do not help build mutual trust," and urged, "The North should stop unnecessary slander and move forward together toward peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula." (청와대는 김여정 노동당 노동당 부장이 지난 20일 발표한 담화에서 한국을 향한 조롱과 막말을 쏟아낸 데 대해 21일 “우리 정부와 대통령에 대한 비방적 언사는 상호 신뢰를 쌓아가는 데 도움이 되지 않는다”며 “북측은 불필요한 비방을 멈추고 한반도 평화 공존을 향해 함께 나아갈 것을 촉구한다”는 입장을 냈다.)

The Blue House added, "The government will consistently pursue a policy of peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula based on mutual respect," and "As a party to peace on the Korean Peninsula, the government will also continue close coordination with the United States." It further stated, "We will also make active efforts as a pacemaker to resume North Korea-U.S. dialogue." This reaffirmed support for President Trump's statement that he would meet with North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un within the year. (청와대는 그러면서 “정부는 상호 존중에 기초한 한반도 평화 공존 정책을 일관되게 추진해 나갈 것”이라며 “또한 정부는 한반도 평화의 당사자로서 한미 간 긴밀한 공조를 지속해나갈 것”이라고 했다. “페이스메이커로서 북미 대화 재개를 위한 적극적인 노력도 경주해나갈 것”이라고도 했다. 트럼프 대통령이 연내 김정은 북한 국무위원장과 만날 것이라고 한 데 대한 지지 의사를 재차 밝힌 것이다.)

Earlier, in her statement, Kim Yo-jong, referring to the reduction of the South Korea-U.S. joint exercise "Ulchi Freedom Shield (UFS)" under the direction of U.S. President Donald Trump, said, "At Trump's word, Seoul was forced to pack up its favorite war-game board, landing in a pitiful predicament." (앞서 김여정은 담화에서 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령의 지시로 한미 연합 훈련인 ‘을지 자유의 방패(UFS)’ 훈련이 축소되자 “트럼프의 말 한마디에 서울은 제일 즐겨 하던 전쟁놀이 판을 거두어야 하는 가긍(可矜)한 처지에 놓이게 됐다”고 했다.)

Kim Yo-jong also said of President Lee Jae-myung, "In front of others, he flatters with embarrassing words like 'expressing respect' for Trump's decision to reduce the exercises or calling it 'a big decision born of deep deliberation,' but behind his back he talks about self-reliant defense and securing independent military capabilities in preparation for a worst-case scenario—Lee's two-faced words and actions perfectly reveal South Korea's restless and contradictory psychology." North Korea also fired about ten short-range ballistic missiles (SRBMs) into the East Sea on the afternoon of the 20th. (김여정은 이재명 대통령에 대해서도 “앞에서는 트럼프의 연습 축소 결단에 ‘경의를 표한다’느니, ‘고심이 담긴 큰 결정’이라느니 하는 낯간지러운 소리로 아첨하고 뒤에 돌아앉아서는 최악의 시나리오에 대비한 자주 국방과 독자적인 군사력 확보를 운운한 이재명의 안팎이 다른 이중적언행은 한국의 불안 초조한 모순 심리를 그대로 보여주고 있다”고 했다. 북한은 20일 오후엔 동해상으로 SRBM 10여 발을 발사하기도 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok and Jang Dong-hyuk to Meet at National Assembly on the 24th... First Face-to-Face Between Ruling and Opposition Leaders (김민석·장동혁, 24일 국회서 회동… 與野 대표 첫 대면)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok and Jang Dong-hyuk to Meet at National Assembly on the 24th... First Face-to-Face Between Ruling and Opposition Leaders (김민석·장동혁, 24일 국회서 회동… 與野 대표 첫 대면)

Kim Min-seok, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, and Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, will meet at the National Assembly on the 24th. This will be the first time Kim meets Jang since he was elected party leader at the Democratic Party's national convention on the 17th. (김민석 더불어민주당 대표와 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 오는 24일 국회에서 회동한다. 김 대표가 지난 17일 민주당 전당대회에서 당대표로 선출된 뒤 장 대표와 만나는 것은 처음이다.)

A key official from the Democratic Party said in a phone call with this newspaper on the 21st, "Leader Kim plans to meet with Jang and other People Power Party leadership at the National Assembly on the morning of the 24th," adding, "It will be a courtesy meeting in line with his inauguration as the new party leader." An official from Jang's side also said, "We understand that Kim's side reached out first." (민주당 핵심 관계자는 21일 본지 통화에서 " 김 대표는 24일 오전 국회에서 장 대표 등 국민의힘 지도부와 만날 예정“이라면서 ”신임 당대표 취임에 따른 상견례 성격의 자리“라고 했다. 장 대표 측 관계자도 ”김 대표 측에서 먼저 연락이 온 것으로 안다”고 했다.)

The two are expected to exchange views on major political issues where the ruling and opposition parties have recently been at odds, including the status of Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae and the special counsel bill on manipulated indictments. Given that Kim has emphasized party-government relations and cross-party cooperation since taking office, the operation of the National Assembly and handling of livelihood-related bills are also likely to be on the agenda. (두 사람은 최근 여야가 맞서고 있는 조희대 대법원장 거취 문제와 조작기소 특검법 등 주요 정치 현안에 대해 의견을 나눌 것으로 보인다. 김 대표가 취임 이후 당정 관계와 여야 협치를 강조해온 만큼 향후 국회 운영과 민생 법안 처리 문제도 대화 테이블에 오를 가능성이 있다.)

After his meeting with Jang, Kim plans to meet Shin Jang-sik, leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, on the same day. He also intends to meet sequentially with the leadership of the Progressive Party, the Reform Party, and the Basic Income Party. (김 대표는 장 대표와의 회동 이후 같은 날 신장식 조국혁신당 대표를 만날 예정이다. 이어 진보당과 개혁신당, 기본소득당 지도부와도 차례로 만날 계획이다.)

item.title: Ruling Party Once Demanded Impeachment of Supreme Court Chief Justice... Now Calls for Abolishing the Court Administration Office (與, 대법원장 탄핵 외치더니... 손발 법원행정처까지 “없애자”)
item.description:
Ruling Party Once Demanded Impeachment of Supreme Court Chief Justice... Now Calls for Abolishing the Court Administration Office (與, 대법원장 탄핵 외치더니... 손발 법원행정처까지 “없애자”)

Following the Democratic Party of Korea's calls for Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae's resignation and impeachment, discussions have resurfaced about abolishing the Court Administration Office to reduce the chief justice's judicial administrative authority. Triggered by the controversy over the written nomination of Supreme Court justice candidates, the offensive appears to be expanding beyond Cho's personal fate to calls for changing the judicial administrative system itself. (더불어민주당에서 조희대 대법원장 사퇴·탄핵론에 이어 대법원장의 사법행정 권한을 축소하는 ‘법원행정처 폐지론’까지 다시 나왔다. 대법관 후보 서면 제청 논란을 계기로 조 대법원장 개인의 거취 문제를 넘어 사법행정 체제 자체를 바꾸자는 주장으로 공세가 확대되는 모습이다.)

Kim Seung-won, the Democratic Party's secretary on the National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee, mentioned Cho's written nomination of Supreme Court justice candidates on a radio program on the 21st, saying, "Ultimately, the imperial chief justice system is what committed such irrationality and illegality." He argued that judicial reform is needed to disperse the chief justice's judicial administrative authority, proposing the establishment of a Judicial Administration Committee and the abolition of the Court Administration Office. (국회 법제사법위원회 민주당 간사인 김승원 의원은 21일 라디오에서 조 대법원장의 대법관 후보 서면 제청을 거론하며 “결국 제왕적 대법원장 체제가 이런 불합리, 불법을 행했다고 본다”고 했다. 그러면서 대법원장의 사법행정 권한을 분산하는 사법개혁이 필요하다며 사법행정위원회를 신설하고 법원행정처를 폐지하는 방안을 주장했다.)

Kim proposed eliminating the current Court Administration Office and replacing it with a "Court Affairs Office" responsible for execution duties. Key matters such as judge appointments and personnel should be decided by a separate collegiate body, dispersing the authority concentrated in the sole chief justice. The Court Administration Office, under the chief justice's direction, oversees judicial administrative affairs including personnel, budget, and accounting for courts nationwide, with its head appointed by the chief justice from among the Supreme Court justices. (김 의원은 현재 법원행정처를 없애고 집행 업무를 담당하는 ‘법원사무처’로 바꾸는 방안을 제시했다. 법관 인사 등 법원의 주요 사항은 별도의 합의제 기구에서 결정하도록 해 대법원장 1인에게 집중된 권한을 분산해야 한다는 것이다. 법원행정처는 대법원장 지휘 아래 전국 법원의 인사·예산·회계 등 사법행정 사무를 총괄하고 있으며 처장은 대법관 가운데 대법원장이 임명한다.)

The abolition of the Court Administration Office is not a new proposal from the Democratic Party. In December of last year, the party's task force on overcoming judicial distrust and normalizing judicial administration introduced a revision to the Court Organization Act that would abolish the Court Administration Office and establish a collegiate Judicial Administration Committee with external participation. The plan would have the committee deliberate and decide on major judicial administration matters such as judge appointments, budget, and discipline, dispersing the chief justice's authority. The bill is currently pending before the Legislation and Judiciary Committee. (법원행정처 폐지는 민주당이 처음 꺼낸 방안은 아니다. 민주당 사법불신 극복·사법행정 정상화 태스크포스(TF)는 지난해 12월 법원행정처를 폐지하고 외부 인사가 참여하는 합의제 사법행정위원회를 설치하는 내용의 법원조직법 개정안을 발의했다. 법관 인사·예산·징계 등 주요 사법행정 사안을 사법행정위가 심의·의결하도록 해 대법원장의 권한을 분산시키는 내용이다. 이 법안은 현재 법사위에 계류돼 있다.)

Although the bill to abolish the Court Administration Office was not actively pursued at the time, the ruling party's secretary on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee has now publicly raised it again amid the recent controversy over Cho's nomination of Supreme Court justices. Within the Democratic Party, demands for Cho's voluntary resignation have recently escalated to impeachment calls. At a Supreme Council meeting held in Gangneung on the same day, Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yun said of Cho, "The grounds for impeachment are now sufficient," and called for the party to consider pursuing impeachment. Kim also argued that Cho's actions could constitute dereliction of duty and abuse of authority, meeting the criteria for impeachment. However, he noted that a process of informing the public about the relevant details would be necessary before actually pursuing impeachment. <<>> Pressure from the National Assembly is also mounting. On the same day, the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, led by the Democratic Party and other ruling bloc members, adopted a motion to summon Cho and Court Administration Office head Noh Kyung-pil as witnesses for an emergency policy inquiry scheduled for the 31st. Three lawmakers including Kim proposed the witness summons, while People Power Party lawmakers walked out in protest. The committee plans to question Cho and Noh about the process of nominating Supreme Court justice candidates, the referral of cases to the Supreme Court's full bench, and the Court Administration Office's procedures for recommending Supreme Court justice candidates. (당시에는 법원행정처 폐지 법안이 본격적으로 처리되지 않았지만 최근 조 대법원장의 대법관 제청 논란을 계기로 여당 법사위 간사가 이를 다시 공개적으로 거론한 것이다. 민주당에선 최근 조 대법원장의 자진 사퇴를 요구하는 데서 나아가 탄핵론까지 잇따라 나오고 있다. 이성윤 최고위원은 이날 강릉에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 조 대법원장에 대해 “탄핵 사유는 이제 충분하다”며 당 차원의 탄핵 추진 검토를 요구했다. 김 의원 역시 조 대법원장의 행위가 직무유기·직권남용에 해당할 수 있다며 탄핵 사유가 된다고 주장했다. 다만 실제 탄핵 추진에 앞서 관련 내용을 국민에게 알리는 과정이 필요하다고 했다.)

The Democratic Party has taken issue with Cho's prolonged delay in nominating a successor for former Justice Noh Tae-ak, as well as his written nomination of judges including Son Bong-ki without face-to-face consultation with President Lee Jae-myung, unlike during the previous Yoon Suk-yeol administration when consultations were held directly with the president. The Supreme Court, on the other hand, maintains that no opportunity for a meeting between the president and the chief justice was arranged, and that the written nomination was made after continued attempts at consultation. Appearing before the Legislation and Judiciary Committee on the 19th, Noh also explained that there is no legal obligation for Cho to appear before the National Assembly when summoned. <<>> The People Power Party has pushed back, arguing that the Democratic Party's pressure on Cho to resign and face impeachment over his constitutional nomination authority, along with the renewed push to abolish the Court Administration Office, constitutes an attempt to "seize control of the judiciary." People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk criticized the ruling bloc for allegedly trying to fill Supreme Court justice positions with pro-government figures appointed during the president's term, while Senior Spokesperson Park Chung-kwon called the Democratic Party's demand for Cho's resignation a "attempt to seize the judiciary." <<>> The conflict between the presidential office and the Supreme Court over the nomination method for a single Supreme Court justice has expanded from demands for Cho's resignation and impeachment and National Assembly witness summons to the issue of reorganizing judicial administration. If the Democratic Party moves to actively process the bill to abolish the Court Administration Office introduced last year, the dispute over Cho's fate is expected to escalate into a clash between the ruling and opposition parties over the chief justice's authority and the operating system of the judiciary. <<>> (국회 차원의 압박도 커지고 있다. 법사위는 이날 민주당 등 범여권 주도로 조 대법원장과 노경필 법원행정처장을 오는 31일 열리는 긴급 현안질의 증인으로 채택했다. 민주당 김승원 의원 등 3명이 증인 출석 요구 안건을 제안했고, 국민의힘 의원들은 이에 반발해 퇴장했다. 법사위는 대법관 후보 제청 과정과 대법원 전원합의체 사건 회부, 법원행정처의 대법관 후보 추천 절차 등을 조 대법원장과 노 처장에게 묻겠다는 입장이다.)

item.title: Park Jung-sung Named New Trade Minister, Choi Yong-cheol as Fire Agency Chief (신임 통상교섭본부장에 박정성, 소방청장 최용철)
item.description:
Park Jung-sung Named New Trade Minister, Choi Yong-cheol as Fire Agency Chief (신임 통상교섭본부장에 박정성, 소방청장 최용철)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 20th appointed Park Jung-sung, Deputy Trade Minister for Trade, as the new Minister for Trade Negotiations at the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (MOTIE). The appointment follows the dismissal of former Trade Minister Yeo Han-koo last week. (이재명 대통령은 20일 산업통상부(산업부) 통상교섭본부장에 박정성 산업부 통상차관보를 임명했다. 지난주 여한구 전 통상교섭본부장의 면직에 따른 인사다.)

The new Trade Minister Park, a native of Daegu, graduated from Seoul National University's Department of Economics and passed the 40th Higher Civil Service Examination, after which he has consistently worked at MOTIE. He has served as the senior working-level representative of the ministry's task force for U.S. tariff negotiations and as head of the Trade and Investment Office. (박 신임 통상교섭본부장은 대구 출신으로 서울대 경제학과를 졸업, 행정고시 40회에 합격한 뒤 줄곧 산업부에서 일해왔다. 산업부 대미관세협상 TF(태스크포스) 실무수석대표, 무역투자실장 등을 맡았다.)

Kang Yu-jung, Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations, said in a written briefing, "Minister Park is a seasoned trade official who has held key positions in trade and trade policy for nearly 30 years," adding, "He has overseen the working-level coordination of tariff and investment negotiations with the U.S., and we judged him to be the right person to maintain continuity in negotiations amid urgent U.S. trade issues and maximize national interests." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 서면 브리핑을 통해 “박 통상교섭본부장은 30년 가까이 통상 및 무역정책 분야 핵심 보직을 두루 거친 정통 통상 관료”라며 “대미 관세 및 투자 협상의 실무 총괄을 맡아와 급박한 대미 통상 현안 속에서 협상의 연속성을 유지하며 국익을 극대화할 적임자로 판단했다”고 밝혔다.)

The President also appointed Choi Yong-cheol, Deputy Commissioner of the National Fire Agency, as its new Commissioner. Choi, a native of Boeun, North Chungcheong Province, graduated from Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, entered the service as a member of the 10th fire officer intake, and has served as head of the South Jeolla Province Fire Headquarters and acting head of the Gyeonggi Province Fire and Disaster Headquarters. He also has experience being dispatched to the National Crisis Management Center under the presidential National Security Office. (이 대통령은 소방청장에는 최용철 소방청 차장을 임명했다. 충북 보은 출신인 최 신임 청장은 한국외국어대를 나와 소방간부 10기로 입직해 전남소방본부장, 경기도 소방재난본부 전담직무대리 등을 맡았다. 청와대 국가안보실 국가위기관리센터에 파견 근무한 이력도 있다.)

Senior Secretary Kang said, "Commissioner Choi is a fire service expert who has spent 27 years across both frontline rescue operations and key policy departments," adding, "He possesses outstanding on-site command skills, strong execution ability, and rich administrative experience, and enjoys high trust within the National Fire Agency for his rational leadership that emphasizes communication and harmony." (강 수석대변인은 “최 청장은 27년 동안 일선 구조 현장과 핵심 정책 부서를 모두 거친 소방 전문가”라며 “탁월한 현장 지휘 능력과 업무 추진력, 풍부한 행정 경험을 겸비했으며, 소통과 화합의 합리적 리더십으로 소방청 내에서 신망도 높다”고 했다.)

Previously, former Commissioner Kim Seung-ryong stepped down in June, just three months after taking office. At the time, the presidential office launched an inspection into Commissioner Kim, and allegations emerged that he had taken a trip abroad for leisure purposes. However, the presidential office did not disclose the specific reasons for the inspection. (앞서 전임 김승룡 소방청장은 지난 6월 취임 3개월 만에 물러났다. 당시 청와대가 김 청장에 대한 감찰에 착수했고, 김 청장이 외유성 해외 출장을 다녀왔다는 등의 의혹이 흘러나왔다. 하지만 청와대는 구체적인 감찰 사유는 밝히지 않았다.)

item.title: US Ambassador Steel's Fine-Print Correction: "National Assembly Library Books Were Lent, Not Donated" (“국회도서관 책, 기증 아니라 대여” 깨알 지적한 스틸 美대사)
item.description:
US Ambassador Steel's Fine-Print Correction: "National Assembly Library Books Were Lent, Not Donated" (“국회도서관 책, 기증 아니라 대여” 깨알 지적한 스틸 美대사)

National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik met with U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Michelle Steel on the 21st and said, "I deeply empathize with and highly appreciate President Trump's will and determination to break the ice for dialogue on the chilled Korean Peninsula and to establish a stable peace regime on the Korean Peninsula." (조정식 국회의장은 21일 미셸 스틸 주한 미국 대사를 만나 “냉각돼 있는 한반도에 대화의 물꼬를 트고 한반도의 안정적 평화 체제를 구축하기 위한 트럼프 대통령의 의지와 결단에 깊이 공감하며 이를 높이 평가한다”고 했다.)

During the meeting with Ambassador Steel at the National Assembly that day, Speaker Woo said, "This year marks the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States and the 73rd anniversary of the Korea-U.S. alliance. I hope that the friendship and cooperation between our two countries, which have together upheld the values of freedom and democracy, will grow even stronger in the future." (조 의장은 이날 국회에서 스틸 대사를 접견한 자리에서 “올해는 미국 건국 250주년이자 한미동맹 73주년이 되는 해다. 그동안 자유와 민주주의 가치를 함께 지켜온 양국의 우정과 협력이 앞으로 더욱 굳건해지기를 바란다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Regarding Ambassador Steel, who is of Korean descent, Speaker Woo said, "She has demonstrated extensive experience and capability in U.S. politics, including as a federal congresswoman, and because she has a deep understanding of and affection for Korea, I expect she will be a great asset to the development of Korea-U.S. relations." (조 의장은 한국계인 스틸 대사에 대해 “연방 하원의원 등 미국 정계에서 많은 경륜과 역량을 발휘해왔고, 한국에 대해서 깊은 이해와 애정을 갖고 있기 때문에 앞으로 한미관계 발전에 큰 힘이 될 거라고 기대한다”고 했다.)

Speaker Woo, who previously served as co-chair of the National Assembly's Korea-U.S. Parliamentary Friendship Association, said, "It would be great if the U.S. Congress had a group like the 'U.S.-Korea Parliamentary Friendship Association,' but there is no proper counterpart right now. I think it would be of even greater help to bilateral relations if one were established in the future." (국회 한미의원연맹 공동 회장을 맡았던 조 의장은 “미국 의회에도 ‘미한의원연맹’ 같은 그룹이 있으면 좋겠는데 마땅한 카운터파트가 없는 상황”이라며 “앞으로 생기면 양국 관계에 더 큰 도움이 될 거라고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Speaker Woo said, "The National Assembly of the Republic of Korea has a very important legacy symbolizing Korea-U.S. friendship. During the Korean War in 1951, the U.S. Embassy donated 700 books to the refugee National Assembly. That became a crucial starting point for our current National Assembly Library." He added, "Seventy-five years later, our National Assembly Library has grown into a library with the largest collection of public materials in the country. So today, with a grateful heart, I have prepared a plaque of appreciation for the U.S. Embassy." (조 의장은 “대한민국 국회에는 한미 우호를 상징하는 아주 중요한 유산이 있다”며 “1951년 6·25전쟁 당시에 미국 대사관이 피란 국회에 책 700권을 기증했었다. 이것이 현재 우리 국회도서관이 출발하는 중요한 계기가 됐다”고 했다. 이어 “그 후로 75년이 지나서 지금 우리 국회도서관은 국내 최대 규모의 공공자료를 갖춘 도서관으로 성장했다. 그래서 오늘 고마운 마음을 담아서 미 대사관에 감사패를 준비했다”고 했다.)

In response, Ambassador Steel said, "You said the 700 books were 'donated,' but as far as I know, they were 'lent.' I understand that we got them back." This drew laughter from Speaker Woo and the other attendees. Ambassador Steel added, "I am also very pleased that this served as the foundation for the National Assembly Library's beginnings." (스틸 대사는 이에 대해 “책 700권을 ‘기증’했다고 했는데, 제가 알기로는 ‘대여’를 한 걸로 알고 있다”며 “저희가 다시 돌려받는 것으로 이해하고 있다”고 했다. 이에 조 의장을 비롯한 참석자들이 웃음을 터뜨리기도 했다. 스틸 대사는 “이를 바탕으로 국회도서관이 출발하는 계기가 됐다고 해서 저도 굉장히 기쁘게 생각한다”고 했다.)

Ambassador Steel said, "Because I have experience working in Congress, I understand firsthand how important a role (the legislature) plays in shaping foreign policy and international relations. Above all, since our two countries' alliance has a long-standing tradition of 73 years, I believe that is what matters most." (스틸 대사는 “제가 의회에서 일한 경험이 있기 때문에 외교 정책과 국제 관계를 형성하는 데 있어 (국회가) 얼마나 중요한 역할을 하는지 온몸으로 이해하고 있다”며 “무엇보다 양국 동맹이 73년이라는 오랜 유구한 전통을 갖고 있기 때문에 이것이 가장 중요하다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

She said, "I hope that my experience as a lawmaker will serve as an opportunity to deepen bilateral relations, support each other, and gain a deeper mutual understanding of how the National Assembly and the U.S. Congress operate. I look forward to working closely with Speaker Woo." (그는 “의원으로서 일한 경험이 양국의 관계를 보다 심화시키고 서로 뒷받침할 뿐 아니라 어떻게 국회와 미국 의회가 작동하는지 서로 깊이 이해할 수 있는 계기가 되길 바란다”며 “조 의장과 함께 긴밀하게 협력하기를 기대한다”고 했다.)

Regarding Speaker Woo's proposal for a 'U.S.-Korea Parliamentary Friendship Association,' Ambassador Steel also said, "Above all, I believe communication is the most important element, whether at the level of lawmakers or the U.S. Congress. If I can be of help, I would like to actively assist." (스틸 대사는 조 의장이 제안한 ‘미한의원연맹’과 관련해서도 “무엇보다 의원들이나 미국 의회 차원에서도 소통이 무엇보다 가장 중요한 요소라 생각한다”며 “제가 일조할 수 있다면 적극적으로 도움을 드리고 싶다”고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party lawmakers oppose Jang Dong-hyuk's 're-election of all district committee chairs' plan... Will Jang push it through? (국힘 의원들 “장동혁 ‘당협 전원 재선출 案’ 반대”…張, 강행하나)
item.description:
People Power Party lawmakers oppose Jang Dong-hyuk's 're-election of all district committee chairs' plan... Will Jang push it through? (국힘 의원들 “장동혁 ‘당협 전원 재선출 案’ 반대”…張, 강행하나)

At a general assembly of lawmakers on the 21st, the People Power Party gathered opposition to Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's push for 're-election of all district party committee chairs.' Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik decided to convey the outcome of the general assembly to the Supreme Council meeting scheduled for next week. (국민의힘은 21일 의원총회에서 장동혁 대표가 추진하는 ‘당협위원장 전원 재선출’에 대해 반대한다는 뜻을 모았다. 정점식 원내대표는 이 같은 의원총회 결과를 다음 주 열릴 최고위원 회의에서 전달하기로 했다.)

Earlier, at the Supreme Council meeting the previous day, Representative Jang Dong-hyuk had attempted to pass an agenda item to collectively dismiss all district party committee chairs across the 254 National Assembly constituencies nationwide and then re-elect them through party member voting, but he postponed it after lawmakers within the party pushed back. (앞서 장동혁 대표는 전날 최고위원 회의에서 전국 국회의원 지역구 254곳에 있는 당협위원장 전원을 일괄 사퇴시킨 뒤 당원 투표로 재선출하는 안건을 통과시키려 했으나, 당내 의원들이 반발하자 보류하기로 했다.)

Among non-pro-power lawmakers, there was resistance, with remarks such as "Isn't Representative Jang effectively trying to exercise the nomination rights for the 2028 general election in advance?" and "If district committee chairs are elected by party member voting, it will move further away from public sentiment and make victory in the general election more difficult." (비당권파 의원들 사이에서는 “장 대표가 사실상 2028년 총선 공천권을 미리 행사하겠다는 시도 아니냐” “당원 투표로 당협위원장을 선출하면 민심과 더 멀어져 총선 승리가 더 어려워진다”는 반발이 나왔다.)

Chief Deputy Spokesperson Choi Su-jin said in a briefing immediately after the general assembly that day, "To get straight to the conclusion, the view is that we should proceed as before—that is, re-electing (district committee chairs) through the district party council's steering committee," and added, "Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik will convey this content to the Supreme Council." (최수진 원내수석대변인은 이날 의원총회 직후 브리핑에서 “결론부터 말하면 기존 방식대로 하는 것, 즉 당원협의회 운영위원회에서 (당협위원장을) 재선출하는 방식이 좋겠다는 것”이라며 “정점식 원내대표가 이 내용을 최고위에 전달할 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

Deputy Spokesperson Choi conveyed Floor Leader Jeong's remarks, saying, "The intent of choosing district committee chairs through party member selection is good, but right now the party is becoming too chaotic, and if we vote in this manner, party members could become divided. Now is the time to fight the Democratic Party and pursue internal unity." (최 대변인은 “당원의 선택을 통해서 당협위원장을 뽑자는 취지는 좋지만, 지금은 당이 너무 혼란스러워지고, 이런 식으로 투표하게 되면 당원들이 갈라질 수 있다”며 “지금은 민주당과 싸워야 하고 당내 통합을 해야 할 타이밍”이라고 정 원내대표가 말했다고 전했다.)

She continued, "Since re-electing (district committee chairs) through the steering committee is also a provision in the party constitution and rules, we think it is best to simply follow established practice," and added, "We plan to convey this position to the Supreme Council." (이어 “운영위원회를 통해서 (당협위원장을) 재선출하는 방식 또한 당헌·당규에 있는 규정이므로 우리는 그냥 관행대로 가는 것이 좋겠다는 것”이라며 “이 뜻을 최고위원회에 전달할 예정”이라고 했다.)

Representative Jang did not attend the general assembly that day, citing a health checkup. (장 대표는 이날 의원총회에 건강검진을 이유로 불참했다.)

The district party committee chair is the person responsible for managing a constituency and is considered a leading candidate in nominations for the next general election. Typically, if the party has an incumbent lawmaker in that constituency, they concurrently serve as the district committee chair; if there is no incumbent, the chair is appointed through an open application process among outside figures seeking to run in the general election. However, Representative Jang, championing the 'party member-centered party' line, has come forward to restart the selection of all district committee chairs, both incumbent and non-incumbent, from scratch. (당협위원장은 지역구를 맡아 관리하는 책임자로, 다음 총선 공천에서 유력한 주자로 꼽힌다. 통상 해당 지역구에 자당 현역 의원이 있으면 그가 당협위원장을 겸임하고, 현역 의원이 없으면 총선 출마를 노리는 원외 인사들의 공모를 거쳐 당협위원장으로 임명한다. 그런데 장 대표가 ‘당원 중심 정당’ 노선을 앞세우면서 원내·원외 당협위원장 전원을 원점에서 다시 뽑겠다고 나선 것이다.)

Representative Jang plans to revisit the 'replacement of all district committee chairs' agenda item at the party's Supreme Council meeting on the 24th. (장 대표는 오는 24일 당 최고위원 회의에서 ‘당협위원장 전원 교체’ 안건을 다시 논의할 예정이다.)

item.title: Is Ha-young's Great-Grandfather's Land 'Pro-Japanese Property'? Cho Kuk Party's Park Eun-jung Says "It Must Be Confiscated," Justice Deputy Minister Says "We Will Keep a Close Eye on It" (하영 증조부 땅은 ‘친일 재산’? 조국당 박은정 “환수해야” 법무차관 “잘 챙겨 보겠다”)
item.description:
Is Ha-young's Great-Grandfather's Land 'Pro-Japanese Property'? Cho Kuk Party's Park Eun-jung Says "It Must Be Confiscated," Justice Deputy Minister Says "We Will Keep a Close Eye on It" (하영 증조부 땅은 ‘친일 재산’? 조국당 박은정 “환수해야” 법무차관 “잘 챙겨 보겠다”)

A claim was made in the National Assembly that the state should confiscate the property of the family of actress Ha-young (real name Ahn Ha-young), amid controversy that her great-grandfather collaborated with the Japanese colonial authorities. (증조부가 일제에 부역했다는 논란이 인 배우 하영(본명 안하영)씨 가족의 재산을 국가가 환수해야 한다는 주장이 국회에서 나왔다.)

At a plenary session of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee on the 21st, Rep. Park Eun-jung of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party cited media reports that Ha-young's great-grandfather, Ahn Sang-ho, was confirmed to have owned about 2,700 pyeong (approximately 8,900 square meters) of land in the Gunpo, Gyeonggi Province area during the Japanese colonial period, stating, "Ahn was a large landowner who accumulated wealth during the Japanese colonial era, and that property appears to have been pro-Japanese property." According to a report by Weekly Kyunghyang, the land register from the Japanese colonial period shows Ahn holding about 2,700 pyeong of land at 235 Geumjeong-ri, Nammyeon, Siheung-gun (now Siheung-si). The land was expropriated by the state in 1983, but it has not been confirmed whether Ahn's descendants continued to hold the land until 1983 and thus received compensation. <<> The controversy over Ha-young's ancestor's collaboration with Japan began when Ha-young said on a broadcast on the 7th that her family had been doctors for four generations starting with her great-grandfather, stating, "My great-grandfather studied Western medicine in Japan and was the first doctor to open a practice in Korea. He even treated Emperor Gojong." As this great-grandfather was revealed to be Ahn, online communities began a so-called "online grave excavation" reexamining Ahn's activities. This was because it was confirmed that Ahn had been a council member—an executive position—of the Daejeong Friendship Society (Daejeong chinmokhoe), an organization that in 1916 led the Japanese policy of "Ilseon Yunghwa" (merging Japan and Korea into one). <<> It has not been confirmed whether there is a direct connection between Ahn's land in Siheung and the property of Ha-young's family. Rep. Park also said, "It is not certain whether it falls under the target of (confiscation under) the Pro-Japanese Property Confiscation Act." She added, "Ahn is not included in the official list of pro-Japanese collaborators published by the Institute for Ethnic Culture or the Truth Commission on Pro-Japanese Collaborators' Anti-National Acts." <<> Nevertheless, Rep. Park said, "(Ahn) was not a traitor, nor a member of the Japanese parliament, nor did he receive a noble title, but the (Property Investigation) Committee could determine that Ahn was an anti-national actor and that his property was pro-Japanese property." <<> In response, Deputy Minister of Justice Lee Jin-soo said, "The preparatory team for the establishment of the Pro-Japanese Property Investigation Committee is carrying out practical work for its launch in December," and "The committee will work diligently to confiscate pro-Japanese property through various activities beyond existing data." He added, "We will also make sure the committee is smoothly formed and launched properly." <<> The committee, to be established under the Pro-Japanese Property Confiscation Act, which takes effect on December 3, will have the authority to designate pro-Japanese anti-national actors and determine their property as "pro-Japanese property." Property determined to be pro-Japanese becomes state-owned. However, if a third party acquired the property without knowing it was pro-Japanese, or acquired it by paying a legitimate price, the state cannot take it. The committee operated once from 2006 to 2010, confiscating 2,359 parcels of land worth 237.3 billion won at the then-market value. Justice Minister Jung Sung-ho, while preparing for the launch of the second committee, said, "We expect to confiscate at least 32.5 billion won or more in pro-Japanese property." <<> The following is the full text of the Q&A between Rep. Park and Deputy Minister Lee. <<> Rep. Park Eun-jung of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party: Recently, ahead of Liberation Day, the pro-Japanese activities of a celebrity's great-grandfather became an issue. As we mark the 81st anniversary of liberation, public interest in settling pro-Japanese legacies is high. According to today's report on this celebrity's great-grandfather—whose name has now been specifically identified—2,700 pyeong of land in Gunpo was found in land records from the 1910s. This pro-Japanese family appears to have been large landowners holding vast tracts of land around Anyang Station and Gunpo Station. So, the great-grandfather did not accumulate this wealth later as a doctor, but was already a large landowner who had accumulated property during the Japanese colonial period—it appears to have been pro-Japanese property. Coincidentally, the amendment to the Special Act on the State Confiscation of Property of Pro-Japanese Anti-National Actors, which passed the National Assembly in May and which you, Deputy Minister, reported on, takes effect on December 3, and you said a (Property Investigation) Committee would be formed. That's the first time in 16 years. <<> Deputy Minister Lee Jin-soo: That's correct. <<> Rep. Park: Now, regarding this celebrity's great-grandfather, it is not yet certain whether this falls under pro-Japanese property, but in my view, although the celebrity's great-grandfather is not included in the official list (of pro-Japanese anti-national actors) published by the Institute for Ethnic Culture or the past Truth Commission, this committee could make a determination. That is, he was not a traitor, nor a member of the Japanese parliament, nor did he receive a noble title, nor was he a councilor of the Central Advisory Institute, but under the committee's other determination provisions, this could be judged as pro-Japanese property and him as an anti-national actor. According to a paper published in 2007 by a senior research fellow at the Institute for Historical Studies, this great-grandfather was listed in 1916 as a council member—an executive position—of the Daejeong Friendship Society, which the Japanese Government-General's Police Bureau defined as an organization whose purpose was to endorse governor-general rule and promote the merger of Japan and Korea (naeseon yunghwa). <<> Under the Pro-Japanese Property Confiscation Act and the Special Act I mentioned earlier (the Special Act on the Truth Investigation of Anti-National Acts Under Japanese Colonial Rule), it seems possible to determine whether someone can be designated as a pro-Japanese anti-national actor by comprehensively reviewing the nature of their organizational activities, their leading role, the degree of involvement in naeseon yunghwa, and whether there was compensation for collaborating with colonial rule. <<> Therefore, even if someone was omitted from past lists, I believe the Ministry of Justice must respond to the public's anger—the anger that descendants have unjustly inherited such pro-Japanese property, accumulated wealth, and that three generations of pro-Japanese collaborators are living lavishly—by ensuring the state confiscates all such pro-Japanese property without exception. I hope you, Deputy Minister, will take an interest in and oversee the committee launching in December. I'd like your response. <<> Deputy Minister Lee: Yes, the preparatory team has been formed and is carrying out practical work for the December launch. As the Minister explained, the minimum expected confiscation amount is 32.5 billion won, but that figure is based on the information we currently have without investigative authority. Once the committee is launched, it will operate for up to five years. We expect the committee to act with independence and work diligently to confiscate pro-Japanese property through various activities beyond existing data. We will also make sure the committee is smoothly formed and launched properly. (박은정 조국혁신당 의원은 21일 국회 법제사법위원회 전체회의에서 하영의 증조부 안상호씨가 일제강점기에 경기 군포시 일대에 2700평(약 8900㎡) 땅을 갖고 있었던 것이 확인됐다는 언론 보도를 인용하면서 “안씨가 일제강점기에 재산을 축적한 대지주였고, 그 재산은 친일 재산이었던 것으로 보인다”고 했다. 주간경향 보도에 따르면, 일제강점기 토지조사부에는 안씨가 시흥군(현 시흥시) 남면 금정리 235번지에 땅 2700평을 갖고 있는 것으로 나온다. 이 땅은 1983년에 국가에 수용됐으나, 안씨 후손이 그 땅을 1983년까지 계속 갖고 있었는지, 그래서 보상금을 받아갔는지는 확인되지 않았다.)
